$comment: #EXP-1456 (owner 2026-10-30): WHERE AN INBOX ROW OPENS ×4, the inbox row tap and the push tap alike. inboxRowTarget(row): a row with `issueId` opens its ISSUE (an `agent_message` about an issue opens that issue's Results face, EXP-933; every other issue row the issue). An issue-less row (`agent_message`, `session_blocked`) with `sessionId` opens THAT SESSION, whatever its type: an Assistant's or team agent's decision (#EXP-1439: question or plan card, `agent_message` titled `copy.decisionPush` of agent-settings.json), an @mention in a conversation (EXP-1291), a wall (EXP-980). An issue-less row without a session (an agent's broadcast, a device share removal, a pruned session) opens NOTHING. #EXP-1534: an `agent_signed_out` row (one of the viewer's devices lost a login it held healthy: one row per login until it reads `ok` again, server-decided) is team-less and carries `deviceId` (the devices row id; absent = null): it opens THAT DEVICE'S SETTINGS (the Devices page with the device's settings open, where its logins are repaired) on every client; a removed device (`deviceId` null) opens nothing. It lists in the inbox of every team (it belongs to the viewer, not a team), as the same issue-less message row as a wall, with the `notification-agent-signed-out` concept icon. Any other issue-less type is not listed. Every tap marks the row read first. sessionTarget(session, viewerId): where a session opens, the S-3 inter-session rule (web lib/session-back.ts): the VIEWER's OWN agent CONVERSATION ROOT (its root is itself, carries `agentId`, and `userId` = the viewer) opens the AGENT's page (its channel: the waiting question or plan sits in its dock); a chat ROOT opens the CHAT; a chat's CHILD opens inside its chat (`chatId` + `sessionId`); anything else under an agent (a teammate's conversation, a child of a conversation) opens AS A SESSION on its own screen. `rootId` null = the row is its own root. A session the client has not synced opens the session route's not-found state, never nothing. A SESSION ROW LANDS ON ITS CARD ×4 (waiting-cards.json DEEP LINKS, Danny 2026-11-13): a question / plan push carries its card (notification-actions.json `messageId` + `cardKind`, question-push.json `rootId`), an inbox row takes the session's waiting card (chat-row-action `sessionWaitingCard` over ALL its synced messages, never the chat's newest-200 window); a plan opens THE plan page, a question its chat at that card (web/desktop `?card=`, phones the chat's card page; a descendant's card opens that session in place, `waitingTarget`) as THE pending deep link (paged in, centred, rung); no card, no root, or a session on its own screen = the session as above. Mirrors: TS src/inbox-route.ts, desktop `domain::inbox_route`, iOS ExpCore `InboxRoute.swift`, Android `domain/InboxRoute.kt`.
